name: Life Script
oneLine: An unconscious life plan, decided in childhood, reinforced by parents, justified by later events, and aimed at a chosen final scene.
whatYouDid: You read twenty-five lines of Imran's childhood and traced how a six-year-old's private decision is still writing his afternoons at thirty-four.
confusion: Script as fate rather than decision

fromBook.quote: a life plan made in childhood, reinforced by the parents, justified by subsequent events, and culminating in a chosen alternative

expand.definition: Script is decisional - the child decides, parents only influence - made outside of awareness, and directed toward a payoff: the closing scene the child wrote before they had words for it.
expand.otherFraming: Steiner's version of the same idea foregrounds the Stroke Economy and banal or hamartic outcomes rather than Berne's 'chosen alternative' framing - same architecture, different emphasis on what drives it.
expand.tryThisToday: Write one sentence for the title of your own life story - then notice what you flinched at, and why.
